text:
lucas: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need to lock owners and short deadlines for the GPU autoscale items — quota guardrails, scheduler experiments, headroom playbook, and alert automation. Keep replies to a line or two.

priya: I can own the quota guardrails (per-customer burst caps + rolling credit). Will post a short spec by Tue EOD.

sara: I'll coordinate the runbook and comms. Draft runbook with thresholds (20/10/5%) ready by Fri.

miguel: For quota: propose percent-of-commit cap + 5-min credit bucket + admin override. Will write numbers & API changes by Tue.

kevin: Scheduler tuning on me. Plan: memory-weighted bin-packing, node reservation for long-lived models, and restrict group preemption to preemptible pools. Small staging sweep Wed/Thu.

ashley: I'll add the auto-rollout gating and comms templates to the runbook. Also include dedicated customer exemptions. Draft by Thu.

dmitri: Ops automation: ops-bot will post a daily spare GPU snapshot and create REM ticket when spare_gpus < 15% for two consecutive checks. I'll prototype the alert + ticket flow next Mon.

lucas: Good. Two extra asks: 1) add a 48h spike-validation after any remediation, 2) include region-level gates for rollouts.

priya: Noted. I'll include the 48h validation step and a short FAQ for sales overrides.

kevin: Quick config snippet I'll test in staging (pseudo-yaml):

```
clusterPolicy:
  binPacking:
    weightMemory: 1.6
    weightCPU: 1.0
  preemption:
    enabled: true
    scope: group
  desiredHeadroom: 0.20
```

priya: One operational detail: enforce per-customer burst caps at the API layer + a soft global throttle switch for SRE to toggle in emergencies.

sara: Runbook note: "auto-rollouts disabled when spare_gpus < 25% (manual approval required)." Ashley will add comms templates for that.

dmitri: ops-bot alert proto (PromQL-style):
```
alert: LowSpareGPUs
expr: spare_gpus_percent < 15
for: 10m
labels: { severity: "warning" }
```
On second fire, create REM and ping #oncall.

miguel: Timeline recap: quota spec Tue (1975637600), scheduler results Thu (1975807200), runbook + rollouts Thu (1975807200), ops-bot prototype Mon (1975940800).

sara: I'll create the REM tickets now and schedule a weekly checkpoint until everything's closed. ops-bot, set a recurring reminder?

ops-bot: reminder-created: "Headroom playbook weekly sync" every Mon 09:30 in #incidents. first_run_ts: 1975624200. jira-created: REM-11021 assigned-to: priya, REM-11022 assigned-to: kevin, REM-11023 assigned-to: sara.

kevin: One more: consider a safety cap to pause auto-rollouts when region-level spare_gpus < 30% during large model ramps. I'll add notes to my tuning doc.

ashley: Adding that to runbook — region gates + manual approval. Also adding a short rollback checklist.

lucas: Excellent. Owners summary here: quota guardrails - priya (Tue 1975637600); scheduler tuning - kevin (Thu 1975807200); headroom runbook + rollout caps - sara/ashley (Thu 1975807200); ops-bot alerts - dmitri (Mon 1975940800). Close this thread when REM tickets have PR links and initial drafts are posted.

priya: Will post the quota spec in thread when ready.

kevin: Will drop staging results + perf numbers here.

dmitri: Prototype alert flow will be in #eng-sre staging channel, will link back.

sara: Thanks all. We'll review during the weekly sync. :thumbsup:
